item.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter - echoX
item.description: “I’m okay,” she says as she pieces together a soft smile. I’ve heard my mother say things were okay for years, but I knew it was never true. Staying in motels and shelters, my mother disappearing for days without a word, holding our breath when my (now former) stepfather walked through the door. These weren’t things to be okay with, but to my mother they were. At least, that’s what I thought.
